events.verdict: Duarte (IND) maintains a legal guarding position defending LeVert (CLE).
Haliburton (IND) cleanly deflects the ball away from LeVert (CLE).

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Haliburton (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Allen (CLE) firms up in a screening position in Duarte's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
Duarte (IND) places a marginal hand to LeVert's (CLE) back that does not affect his SQBR.
Okoro (CLE) legally contests the jump shot attempt by Haliburton (IND).
Hield (IND) and LeVert (CLE) briefly engage and disengage.  The contact is marginal and does not affect LeVert's FOM.
Smith (IND) and Allen (CLE) briefly engage and disengage and the contact does not affect Allen's ability to set the pick.
Okoro (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position on Haliburton (IND) during the drive and the contact is incidental.
Haliburton (IND) commits a take foul on Rondo (CLE).
Brissett (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of LeVert (CLE) and absorbs the contact.
LeVert (CLE) places a hand to the front of Duarte (IND) on the drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
